import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: user ratings data
# Schema: ['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp']
df_ratings = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1: movie metadata
# Schema includes 'item_id' and 'movie title' among others
df_movies = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# We only need 'item_id' and 'movie title' from Source 1 for the target
df_movies_reduced = df_movies[['item_id', 'movie title']]

# Merge ratings with movie titles on 'item_id'
df_merged = pd.merge(df_ratings, df_movies_reduced, on='item_id', how='left')

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# ['user_id': int, 'item_id': int, 'rating': int, 'timestamp': int, 'movie title': str]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
df_merged['user_id'] = df_merged['user_id'].astype(int)
df_merged['item_id'] = df_merged['item_id'].astype(int)
df_merged['rating'] = df_merged['rating'].astype(int)
df_merged['timestamp'] = df_merged['timestamp'].astype(int)
df_merged['movie title'] = df_merged['movie title'].astype(str)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_target = df_merged[['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'movie title']]

# Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
